messages:
sophie-support: Heads-up — Greenline GmbH invoice #INV-2026-187 is on hold. Customer says reverse-charge should apply but our VAT check failed. They uploaded a national VAT extract (PDF) + a resale cert. tax-validate returned 'vat_id_mismatch'. Can billing/legal advise?

adrian-billing: Thanks. Can you paste the invoice/order id, the VAT ID they supplied, and the attachment link?

sophie-support: Invoice INV-2026-187, VAT ID provided: DE123456789. Our system stored company name as 'Greenline GmbH' but the registry PDF shows 'Greenline GmbH & Co. KG'. Attachment: https://files.redwood/gl-2476/vat-extract.pdf 

# API response we got from tax-validate (copied from logs):
```
{
  "vat_id": "DE123456789",
  "status": "invalid",
  "reason": "name_mismatch",
  "service": "tax-verify.prod",
  "raw": "Name 'Greenline GmbH' != 'Greenline GmbH & Co. KG'"
}
```

adrian-billing: OK. If Legal confirms the registry snapshot is authoritative we can mark the invoice B2B-exempt and release. We need a short justification note and a copy of the registry page attached to the invoice.

lisa-legal: Quick read — a national registry snapshot that includes VAT ID + company name + date is acceptable evidence for DE. The '& Co. KG' suffix is a common organizational form; we should normalize names when doing automated checks. Send the registry link/screenshot and I'll sign off.

sophie-support: Registry lookup link: https://tax-de.gov/registry/DE123456789 — page shows 'Greenline GmbH & Co. KG', status 'active', date 2026-03-16. Screenshot uploaded to the case.

naveen-engineering: FYI our tax-validate service currently flags 'name_mismatch' (422) when normalized_name != supplied_name. Normalization today strips punctuation and collapses whitespace. Suggest we add a normalization pass to strip connector tokens like '& Co', 'Co. KG', 'AG', etc., and compare base tokens. I can produce a small patch or add a fallback that accepts registry-confirmed IDs.

adrian-billing: Operational ask: can billing manually flip an exemption flag to get the invoice out of 'on hold' while eng and legal update the automation? We need to avoid customer churn.

lisa-legal: Confirming — based on the registry snapshot and matching business address, legal approves manual acceptance. Please attach the registry screenshot to the invoice and set tax_exempt=true with note 'manual acceptance per legal 2026-03-17'.

adrian-billing: Done. Marked INV-2026-187 tax_exempt=true, attached registry screenshot, and released to accounting. Action ref SUP-53421.

billing-bot: Ticket SUP-53421 created: invoice INV-2026-187 manual VAT exemption applied by adrian-billing. Audit: lisa-legal sign-off present. Link: https://support.redwood/sup/53421

sophie-support: Great — looping back to customer now. They confirmed they received the updated invoice. Closing thread. :thumbsup:
